descriptionHtml:
Onikuma X12 RGB Gaming Headset with 40mm Drivers and Noise-Canceling Microphone

Immerse yourself completely into the gaming battlefield and upgrade your spatial awareness with the Onikuma X12 RGB Gaming Headset. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance PC hardware audio peripheral is masterfully engineered for competitive esports players, tactical stream operators, and active digital website managers across Egypt who demand precise acoustic accuracy, crystal-clear team communication, and long-session comfort. Built with a robust yet lightweight aluminum frame framework to withstand intense gaming runs, this headset is backed by an official 1-year warranty for absolute peace of mind.

The Onikuma X12 is driven by premium 40mm magnetic neodymium speaker units that deliver crisp highs, clean mid-tones, and booming directional bass layouts to help you pinpoint enemy footsteps with ease. It features an adjustable omnidirectional noise-canceling microphone line that filters out ambient room sounds for clear voice capture. For absolute luxury during extended play, the over-ear cups are wrapped in soft, breathable memory foam cushion materials. Finished with striking breathing-gradient RGB illumination lighting powered via its built-in USB line, the headset features a multi-platform 3.5mm connector array ready for PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and mobile devices.
